## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A fault-injection test killing the process between started and completed...

The system SHALL ensure that a fault-injection test killing the process between started and completed shows replayable re-runs once, verify_then_skip probes and records completed without a second side effect, and never_replay parks the change with a named escalation and performs no action.

#### Scenario: A fault-injection test killing the process between started and completed...

WHEN `add-effects-journal-core-with-replay-policies` is implemented
THEN A fault-injection test killing the process between started and completed shows replayable re-runs once, verify_then_skip probes and records completed without a second side effect, and never_replay parks the change with a named escalation and performs no action.

### Requirement: Idempotency keys are identical across two runs with the same inputs and...

The system SHALL ensure that idempotency keys are identical across two runs with the same inputs and contain no wall-clock-dependent component.

#### Scenario: Idempotency keys are identical across two runs with the same inputs and...

WHEN `add-effects-journal-core-with-replay-policies` is implemented
THEN Idempotency keys are identical across two runs with the same inputs and contain no wall-clock-dependent component.

### Requirement: The journal works with the coordinator unreachable; any coordinator copy is...

The system SHALL ensure that the journal works with the coordinator unreachable; any coordinator copy is an optional persist-first projection never written back into the journal.

#### Scenario: The journal works with the coordinator unreachable; any coordinator copy is...

WHEN `add-effects-journal-core-with-replay-policies` is implemented
THEN The journal works with the coordinator unreachable; any coordinator copy is an optional persist-first projection never written back into the journal.

### Requirement: docs/guides/state-artifacts.md lists the effects journal with holder,...

The system SHALL ensure that docs/guides/state-artifacts.md lists the effects journal with holder, writer, authority, consumers, and missing/stale behavior, scoped to "did this effect happen?" only.

#### Scenario: docs/guides/state-artifacts.md lists the effects journal with holder,...

WHEN `add-effects-journal-core-with-replay-policies` is implemented
THEN docs/guides/state-artifacts.md lists the effects journal with holder, writer, authority, consumers, and missing/stale behavior, scoped to "did this effect happen?" only.

### Requirement: Journal entries are bounded in size and store results (PR URL, commit SHA),...

The system SHALL ensure that journal entries are bounded in size and store results (PR URL, commit SHA), never transcripts.

#### Scenario: Journal entries are bounded in size and store results (PR URL, commit SHA),...

WHEN `add-effects-journal-core-with-replay-policies` is implemented
THEN Journal entries are bounded in size and store results (PR URL, commit SHA), never transcripts.
